artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan wrapping 2 of the 4 scoped READMEs in cols=files-lines generated-inventory blocks, with the 2 Kamp rollup tables recorded as a reasoned exclusion.

memory_candidates.content: When converting a hand-maintained markdown table into a generated-inventory block whose column set GROWS (e.g. check-module-invariants.sh cols=lines -> cols=files-lines), every existing data row must be padded to the new cell count BEFORE the first --emit-inventory run. render_block() carries a row's description forward only when len(cells) >= ncols; any short row silently gets '<!-- TODO: add description -->' instead. The failure is total and silent: wrapping a 15-row table without padding regenerates all numbers correctly and destroys all 15 descriptions. The hazard is easy to half-fix, because loose-file rows are the obvious ones to pad and subdirectory rollup rows are the ones usually forgotten.
